tasks.description: The link should be placed on the login page and should open a form for the user to enter their email address. This form should be accessible and follow the existing design guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user on the login page, when they click the 'Forgot password?' link, then a form to enter their email address is displayed.

tasks.description: Generate a single-use, time-limited token upon user request for password reset. The token should be unique and follow security best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when the system generates a token, then the token is unique, single-use, and time-limited.

tasks.description: The form should allow users to enter and confirm a new password. It should validate the token before accepting the new password and reject expired, already-used, or invalid tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a valid reset token, when they enter and confirm a new password, then the password is updated if the token is valid and not expired.

tasks.description: The system should send an email to the user's registered address with a link containing the reset token. The email should be secure and follow best practices for password reset emails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when the system sends an email, then the email contains a link with a valid reset token.

tasks.description: Upon successful reset, the system should hash and store the new password using the existing password-hashing scheme.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when the system updates the password, then the new password is hashed and stored correctly.

tasks.description: After a successful password reset, the system should invalidate the user's existing sessions to prevent account takeover.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when the system invalidates old sessions, then previously issued tokens can no longer be used.

tasks.description: The system should validate the reset token before accepting the new password. It should reject expired, already-used, or invalid tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user attempts to reset their password with an invalid token, when the system validates the token, then the reset is rejected.
